virality_data.topic: Building a custom Wolfram Language interpreter in Rust with an iced-based GUI
virality_data.analysis: This focuses on a high-performance system engineering challenge: writing an interpreter for a complex, symbolic language (Wolfram/Mathematica) in Rust. It appeals to senior engineers interested in language design, AST parsing, and building modern, lightweight desktop GUIs with Rust's iced library. It stands out because symbolic computation architecture is rarely covered in mainstream dev blogs.
